candidates.description: This vector represents numeric values that commonly appear as measurements, counts, or data points.
Spanish demonstrative pronouns and determiners indicating proximity.
This vector represents verbs and related terms expressing functionality, utility, or existence in Romance languages.
This vector activates for common Spanish noun and adverb suffix morphemes and their derivatives.
This feature vector represents common Spanish verb stems, suffixes, and inflections.
Tokens starting with or containing the letter sequence "cont-" (or closely related morphological roots).
This vector represents anatomical terms, medical prefixes, and Spanish or place name fragments that share common Latin-root linguistic features.
This vector represents anatomical directional terms and spatial descriptors.
This vector activates for proper names, biological/medical terminology, and Spanish verb roots.
This vector activates strongly on words and subwords ending with the phonetic sequence "-as".
